coverage_method: Token/byte ranges only (tokenize), no AST/compile of sources in packaging; every non-comment/non-layout Python token belongs to exactly one top-level definition or module-statement full region. Packaging coverage, not behavioral verification.
ownership_rule: Every top-level/lexical definition instance and every module statement maps to exactly one owner. Each canonical atomic full current body is embedded verbatim once in its owner payload. Nested definitions inherit the full enclosing body owner. Owners continue the verified v6 package; new symbols and the third test part are assigned explicitly (see owner_assignment).

owner_assignment.continuity: v6 coverage d69f336e... owner by (source, kind, symbol); D34->D35, test7->test8

CONTEXT_ONLY_rule: ONLY byte-identical duplicates among the FOUR CURRENT files. No predecessor-only, unchanged-but-unembedded, delta-only, reference-only or omitted body licenses acceptance. Each duplicate has exact source and canonical range/hash; parent must independently compare.
empty_deltas: All comparisons recorded. An empty incremental delta never substitutes for a full current body; that full body is still embedded.
nonstatement_context: Blank lines, standalone comments and shebangs outside definition/statement bodies are not definitions/statements. Whole-source hashes bind them; all comments INSIDE full bodies are included verbatim.
parent_choice: FULL current bodies, ceiling 240000 B; six slices because test8 grew (tests split into three parts); delta-centric packaging not used.
stray_destination_check: Glob review/pa19-v7-v35-* returned no files before exclusive creation. No existing file overwritten/moved/deleted.
verification_boundary: Metadata/byte/token processing only for packaging; separate compile()/symtable source-only checks of the final texts were done before freeze without executing code objects; no tests/native/probe/preflight or review launch.
